create.name: Mouse Savaiano
create.bio:
Mouse Savaiano runs MKE Healing Arts, a small healing practice in Mequon, just north of Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and also works with people over Zoom. A licensed massage therapist by training, they have practised Usui Reiki for more than twenty years and teach it as a Reiki Master Teacher, with one path for people who want to use Reiki for themselves and their families and another for those preparing to offer it professionally. Their own meditation practice began at 26 with mala beads and Sanskrit chanting and has since widened to breath-focused sitting and guided practice.

Much of their teaching now follows the shamanic path. They introduce students to drum-led journeying, in which people meet power animals and helping spirits, and offer ongoing guidance and a year-long mentorship in ritual, ceremony and healing work for those who want to go further. Their spiritual guidance sessions are for people at a turning point, such as a change of career, a relationship ending or children leaving home, and draw on helping spirits and, at times, mediumship. The studio also hosts full-moon gatherings and a monthly drum circle, and the website shares free drum-journey recordings and a guided meditation.

courses.title: Learning to Journey: Introduction to Shamanic Journeying
courses.description: A starting course in shamanic journeying, held over four one-hour sessions in person in Mequon or remotely. Students learn to enter a journey with the drum, meet their helping spirits and work with clear intention and safe guidelines. It is the first step before their shamanic guidance sessions and year-long mentorship.

courses.title: Spiritual Guidance Sessions
courses.description: One-hour sessions on Zoom or in person for people facing a life transition who want spiritual support and clarity. Mouse works with helping spirits and, at times, mediumship to offer insight and practical next steps. Single sessions, a four-session pack and a monthly year-long option are offered.
courses.price: $135 single session; $440 for 4 sessions; $1,380 for 12 sessions

courses.title: Study Usui Reiki Ryoho
courses.description: Usui Reiki training in two tracks: a personal path for using Reiki on yourself and loved ones, and a professional mastery series for those who want to become Reiki Masters and offer sessions to the public. Taught by Mouse as a Reiki Master Teacher.

free_resources.title: Videos and Meditations
free_resources.description: Free recordings on the MKE Healing Arts site, including a fifteen-minute guided cord-cutting meditation, shamanic drum recordings for journeying with a call back, and the first day of a 21-day Reiki meditation.
